critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: FastAPI route-ordering bug — PUT /api/admin/testimonials/settings was declared AFTER PUT /api/admin/testimonials/{tid}, so requests to /settings matched {tid} and returned 422 (missing name/content fields). Moved settings endpoint above the {tid} routes. Applied in /app/backend/server.py.
server.py is 4288 lines — recommend splitting into modules (testimonials, products, orders) for maintainability.
TestimonialCarousel currently shows only when items exist; storefront section verified with 1 approved testimonial from smoke test.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 endpoints verified. If revisiting, note only 2 products (both drafts) exist in DB — reorder tests use draft group. TestimonialCarousel selector = data-testid='testimonials-section'. Public page selector = data-testid='testimonials-page'. Admin sub-tabs found via text match: Menunggu/Ditampilkan/Disembunyikan/Posting Admin/Settings.
rca of the issue: Route-ordering bug: FastAPI matches path routes in registration order. Because PUT /admin/testimonials/{tid} was registered first, requests to /admin/testimonials/settings were matched with tid='settings' expecting a TestimonialAdminCreate body (which requires name+content). Fix: register the literal /settings route before the parametric /{tid} route.
